def kmp_search(pat={{pattern}}, txt={{text}}):
    m = len(pat); nxt = [0]*m
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, m):
        while j and pat[i] != pat[j]: j = nxt[j-1]
        if pat[i] == pat[j]: j += 1
        nxt[i] = j
    res = []; j = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(txt):
        while j and c != pat[j]: j = nxt[j-1]
        if c == pat[j]: j += 1
        if j == m:
            res.append(i - m + 1); j = nxt[j-1]
    return res
